levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: Round 2 checklist items stay generic ('bring the right stuff') or fewer than three items are listed.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Round 2 checklist lists at least three items, but one or more are vague or only loosely tied to the X-ray scenario.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Round 2 checklist lists at least three specific items clearly tied to the fictional follow-up X-ray appointment.

criteria.dimension: Independent application as support fades from Round 1 to Round 2

levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: Round 2 questions closely copy the wording or structure of the Round 1 sentence starters rather than standing on their own.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Round 2 includes at least two original questions, in the learner's own wording, that were generated without the sentence-starter scaffold.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
